title: Intercantonal agreements (concordats) by domain
source: LexFind (Institute of Federalism, University of Fribourg)
notes: "Other" includes civil law, criminal law and concordats without a legal domain in LexFind's public database (~28% unclassified at the source)
Coverage follows the imported collections — run backfill-lexfind to complete under-represented cantons

Counting unit: canton memberships, not distinct treaties — each agreement counts once per signatory canton whose collection publishes it (a 26-canton concordat counts 26), matching the chstat.ch methodology. Distinct agreements with their signing cantons: /api/v1/stats/concordats_signatories.json
